allow: Shell(echo "== env =="; env | grep -E '^GIT_' || echo none; echo "== cat-file HEAD =="; git cat-file -p HEAD | head -6; echo "== tree =="; git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; echo "== store blob in HEAD =="; git ls-tree HEAD src/lib/store.ts; echo "== blob marker count =="; git cat-file -p $(git ls-tree HEAD src/lib/store.ts | awk '{print $3}') | grep -c transferBetweenAccounts; echo "== replace refs =="; git for-each-ref refs/replace; echo "== grafts =="; cat .git/info/grafts 2>/dev/null || echo none; echo "== reflog =="; git reflog -8)

Shell(npm audit --json > /tmp/ledger-audit.json 2>/dev/null; node -e " const a=require('/tmp/ledger-audit.json'); const rows=Object.entries(a.vulnerabilities||{}).map(([name,v])=>({name,severity:v.severity,direct:v.isDirect,range:v.range,fix:typeof v.fixAvailable==='object'?v.fixAvailable.name+'@'+v.fixAvailable.version:v.fixAvailable})); rows.sort((x,y)=>['critical','high','moderate','low'].indexOf(x.severity)-['critical','high','moderate','low'].indexOf(y.severity)); console.log('total',rows.length); rows.forEach(r=>console.log([r.severity,r.name,r.range,'direct='+r.direct,'fix='+r.fix].join(' | '))); ")
